paper_id: Coupling Distributed and Symbolic Execution for Natural Language Queries
title: Coupling Distributed and Symbolic Execution for Natural Language Queries
motivation: Distributed executors are weak in execution efficiency and interpretability; symbolic executors are efficient but hard to train, especially at early stages (cold start problem).
problem_framing: Natural language table querying requires multiple execution steps. Need to couple distributed (differentiable but slow) and symbolic (efficient but discrete) execution paradigms.
key_insight: Distributed executor's field attention 'generally aligns with column selection' — use this imperfect symbolic interpretation as supervision signal to pretrain symbolic executor, alleviating REINFORCE cold start.
method_signature: Two-way coupling: distributed→symbolic pretraining, then symbolic→distributed feedback using intermediate execution results.
evaluation_criteria: Denotation accuracy, execution accuracy, learning efficiency (epochs to converge), execution efficiency (seconds per query), interpretability.
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: REINFORCE alone takes 2000 epochs to get started and gets stuck in poor local optima; symbolic executor alone cannot recover complicated execution cases.
evidence_for_taste: very difficult to get started at early stages
largely alleviates the cold start problem
thinking_moves: 观察到分布式执行器虽不完美但仍有符号可解释性, 用它做预训练信号
用REINFORCE改进预训练后的策略, 而不是从零开始RL
将符号执行器的中间结果反馈给分布式模型, 实现双向耦合
承认强监督(执行序列标签)不可得的现实约束, 只用denotation弱监督
